harvest_rules.configuration.title: Harvest Rules
harvest_rules.configuration.auto_detect_: Also harvest every block that extends vanilla's CropBlock (most modded crops). #harvest_rules:excluded still wins.
Only harvest when a hoe is in the main hand.
harvest_rules.configuration.hoe_durabili: Durability a held hoe loses per harvest. 0 = none.
harvest_rules.configuration.exhaustion.t: Food exhaustion per harvest. Breaking a block in vanilla costs 0.005.
harvest_rules.configuration.xp_per_harve: Experience points dropped per harvest. 0 = none.
harvest_rules.configuration.respect_prot: Treat a harvest like breaking the block: adventure mode, spawn protection and claim mods can stop it.
